title: Resolve the ACTIVE sprint by status, not sprint_files[-1], across all scripts

verified_files.detail: Shared resolver: sprint_number, list_sprint_files, read_sprint_status, read_sprint_status_file, is_closed_sprint, resolve_active_sprint. Stdlib-only, no import-time side effects (it loads inside PreToolUse/SessionStart hooks).
17 tests including the gate-bug and compute-hours integration scenarios.
get_active_issue resolves by Status; allowlist model, main/master block (ADR-002) and fail-open paths untouched.
Duplicate is_closed_sprint removed; delegates to the shared module.
Fourth defect site, added to the allowlist mid-build. Now searches the ACTIVE board first then every other board, since an issue ID is globally unique and may be carried over.

allowlist_amended.why: Carries the identical sprint_files[-1] defect but was missed when the spec was written; the problem statement named only three sites. Caught by the spec's own DoD grep, not by inspection. Spec amended before editing rather than editing outside the allowlist.

definition_of_done.criterion: No caller selects by last filename
definition_of_done.evidence: All 5 callers import from solorail_state; grep clean in each. The single remaining sprint_files[-1] is the resolver's documented rule-3 fallback on a numerically-ordered list.

definition_of_done.criterion: Gate enforces an IN_PROGRESS issue in an ACTIVE sprint-01 while a CLOSED sprint-02 exists
definition_of_done.evidence: Live fixture: get_active_issue returned E01-ISS-09 from the ACTIVE older board. This is the scenario that failed before.

definition_of_done.criterion: Live gate still blocks and permits correctly
definition_of_done.evidence: scripts/solorail_state.py -> exit 0; README.md -> exit 2 with SCOPE VIOLATION

definition_of_done.criterion: Session banner reports the active sprint

defects_closed: enforce_gate.py:44 selected the last filename, so the gate silently stopped enforcing an IN_PROGRESS issue once a newer sprint file existed
session_start.py:10 could report the banner against a CLOSED sprint
eval_metrics.py:67 could generate telemetry for the wrong sprint
compute_actual_hours.py:40 could miss an issue entirely and fall back to a default, corrupting the hours ADR-003 makes authoritative
Plain string sort put sprint-10.md before sprint-9.md; ordering is now numeric
is_closed_sprint was duplicated between sync_metrics.py and the status-reading logic
notes: Unblocks E03-ISS-03 (status writer) and E03-ISS-04 (next-sprint generation), which both need reliable active-sprint resolution. resolve_active_sprint deliberately falls back to the highest-numbered board rather than returning None when no sprint is ACTIVE, so the gate does not begin failing open the moment every sprint is closed.
